utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Faye, I want to double-check the repair drive details before I spread the word — can you tell me when and where it is?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's this Saturday at the community center, from 10 AM to 2 PM. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, Saturday 10-2 at the community center — got it. Should I bring any tools or just the broken item?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive this Saturday? I can help you carry it over if you need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nah, I'm not bringing items—just handling tool sign-ups. Thanks though

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Ah, gotcha. Well, if you need an extra hand with the tool check-in or anything else, just holler, alright?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Noah! We're all set for Saturday morning at 9. Leo's got his tools ready, and Uli's on board too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, 9 works. I'll have the garage open.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Kira was a bit skeptical about that old USB drive, but I assured her we've got a solid plan—Saturday's going to be a good one!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope we have enough extension cords without them becoming a tripping hazard.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe we can tape them down, or run them along the walls.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Taping them down could work, but I'm still worried about parking—if folks can't find a spot, they might just turn around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think it's for the benches, but honestly, I'm still a bit lost on the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's all about fixing up the old benches and a few other things around the park. Gus is bringing his whole toolbox, so we'll have plenty of help!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, benches, right! Sounds good. I'll try to remember to bring my hammer, but don't count on it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Quinn, I appreciate the invite, but I need to sort out the parking plan before I commit to anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Eli, I heard you're working on the parking plan—did that come up because of the repair drive for the community center?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Nell, it's all part of the same push—the parking plan will help coordinate who's bringing what and where to unload for the repair work.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina, just a heads up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, Sunday? I thought we agreed on Saturday—what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, I know, it was a last-minute change. Rosa told me it's now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Dane, you're just in time—I've got the patchwork list and the park's repair drive is set, but we need to clarify if there's an appliance run too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you actually think that old USB drive is going to fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, Kira, the repair drive is a community event—we're fixing park benches and patching driveways, not using a USB stick.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rosa! Have you heard about the community repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park benches and could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Quinn, I actually just got word that we've moved it to Sunday at the community center instead! Hope you can still make it?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sunday works even better for me! I'll spread the word about the change — can't wait to see everyone there!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Oren, just checking—did you remember what you were supposed to bring, or do you still need a hand figuring it out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Gus! Right, I was supposed to bring something... a lamp? No, wait, it might be a broken clock. I'll go check my attic again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Tell you what, I’ll toss my spare lamp and a few small tools in the truck too, just in case it’s either one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Mara just told me the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. So make sure you spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Sunday at the community center. Did anyone figure out what we're using to fix that old USB drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think Sam mentioned he's got a solid set of tools—maybe he can take a look at that USB drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey, don't forget, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center—bring anything broken!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Vik, I think it's been moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, really? Sunday? Well, make sure to bring your broken things then! I'll tell Rey and Noah about the change.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's about fixing up the community center, but I can't quite remember the details. Are you bringing gear for that, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I figured I'd haul my toolbox over, and maybe some extension cords if we need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Extension cords sound smart—Frank mentioned his hedge trimmer's been acting up, so maybe we'll need 'em for testing stuff too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oren, just a heads up — we've switched the repair drive to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Sunday? Right, I knew that. I think I wrote it down somewhere... or maybe that was my grocery list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Oren! I'll send you a quick reminder tomorrow, and I've got the sign-up sheet for tools if you want to help with that.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Quinn, don't forget the repair drive this Saturday at the community center—bring anything broken you've got!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Already on it, Vik! I've been telling everyone I see—Pia, Opal, even Kira, though she's a bit skeptical. We're gonna make those park benches look brand new!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, the more the merrier! I'm bringing my old toaster—hoping someone can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mina! Repair drive—right, that thing. Is it this weekend or next? I keep mixing it up with the park bench thing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's next Saturday, not this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Next Saturday—got it. I'll mark it down this time, I swear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Sam, I need to update you — the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sunday works for me, Mara. I'll bring my toolbox and meet you at the center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'm glad that still works for you. I'll see you there with my tools too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Opal, I'm glad you're here—are you bringing something to the repair drive too? I'm still sorting out my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I'm bringing my old toaster to the park this weekend—but I've also got a map from Dane showing which driveways need patching, if you're interested.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: A map of driveways? That's actually really helpful—I can drop it off at the school pickup line if it helps coordinate things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa just told me the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center—I'll make sure to bring the bolts and spare parts I've been counting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sunday sounds good, I'll see if I can drop by with that old lamp.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a lamp—perfect! I've got a box of spare bulbs and wiring that might come in handy for that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: And what about parking? If the street fills up, people will just turn around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, parking's always a mess. Just tell me where to drop off my tools for sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Drop-off? That could cause a logjam if everyone shows up at once. Better if you bring them Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday sounds perfect— got any idea what tools we're bringing to revive that old USB drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, Gus is bringing his whole toolbox and some spare parts, so we should be set for most things.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, that's a relief! I'll bring my old laptop just in case we need to test anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Leo, did you say there's a repair drive this weekend? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Saturday morning. Bring your broken stuff by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. And where exactly is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so it's moved to Sunday at the community center now? Are we sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard that from Mrs. Gable at the bakery this morning. She seemed pretty certain about the change.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Huh, Mrs. Gable did mention that? Well, I guess if she said it, it's probably right. Just want to make sure we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: So the repair drive's this Sunday at the community center now? I'll still bring my lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, it's Sunday now—Faye said the center had more room for us to spread out. I'll bring my gardening shears and that USB drive too, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, I'm glad we have more space. My lawnmower's been a real headache, hopefully someone can help me figure it out.
